purposeStatement: A compact, axis-less inline trend line/bars summarising one stat's direction at a glance; NOT a full readable chart with axes/labels and NOT a static status pill (use Badge).

antiPatterns.pattern: An inline <svg> with a raw hex stroke and px width/height to draw a tiny trend line next to a number
antiPatterns.reason: Bypasses the token system and the registry, re-inventing a one-off chart that drifts in colour and sizing

antiPatterns.pattern: Adding axis ticks, gridlines, value labels, or tooltips to convey precise readings
antiPatterns.reason: A sparkline communicates direction only; precise reads belong to a full chart component
